headline: The end-of-campaign thank-you, Version A: the full script, with the client's match line.
story: The thank-you film for everyone who gave to Imagine If: you chose to believe another way is possible, and people around the world are proving it.

Four short proofs, each one of Search's own campaign stories: hands stained from the same dye, a photo traced back before a rumor spread, a leader who started sharing power, water that became a reason to build together.
You imagined it, then you helped build it. Thank you for choosing each other.
do: Build A first: the full script with the match line.
Every story line gets B-roll that shows that story; flag the ones with none.
Keep the pace calm and warm.
End on Chase's horizontal Imagine If bumper.
Then make B by removing the match line (item 13353116822).
dont: No logo, wordmark or title card at 0:00.
Don't paraphrase or trim the script.
No generic footage for the four stories. Flag a missing story on the item.
No freeze frames on a speaker.
